decision_algebra: ANY DENY > ANY INDETERMINATE > ALL PASS

theorem.statement: An EK certificate is admissible only when the exact DER leaf path validates to an explicitly authorized root at the supplied time, the leaf satisfies the RSA storage-EK profile, AuthorityKeyIdentifier binds to the issuing CA SubjectKeyIdentifier, the exact certificate and issuer signatures and both issuer CRL signatures verify from the exact DER/TBS bytes, each issuer CRL is v2 with exact thisUpdate/nextUpdate semantics, non-critical authorityKeyIdentifier and cRLNumber extensions bound to the signing CA, and exact revoked-entry serial/date/reason identities matching the committed reference recipe, a CRL check is PASS, and the prior EK SPKI theorem binds the leaf to the observed EK public key.
theorem.scope: The reference trust anchor is synthetic. This theorem is a deterministic policy model and does not assert real manufacturer authenticity.

required_input.session_binding_sha256: binding over verification mode, session, TPM, certificate chain, trust-anchor state/source, verification time, revocation state/method/CRL, independent cryptographic witness source/input/output/receipt, and SPKI certificate/public-key identity
required_input.cryptographic_binding_sha256: canonical hash of the in-process exact certificate/CRL cryptographic receipt
required_input.cryptographic_binding_source_sha256: SHA-256 of the independently executed cryptographic witness source
required_input.cryptographic_binding_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact cryptographic witness input projection
required_input.cryptographic_binding_output_sha256: SHA-256 of the independently executed cryptographic witness output

crl_semantics.root: exact reference CRL semantic recipe for the root-issued CRL
crl_semantics.intermediate: exact reference CRL semantic recipe for the intermediate-issued CRL

required_input.crl_semantics_sha256: canonical hash of the exact committed crl_semantics object

profile_rules.key_usage: critical keyEncipherment for RSA storage EK
profile_rules.extended_key_usage: optional; if present it should contain 2.23.133.8.1
profile_rules.authority_key_identifier: MUST be present and non-critical; keyIdentifier is required and optional issuer/serial fields must be structurally valid
profile_rules.crl_issuer_key_usage: every certificate acting as a CRL issuer must have critical Key Usage with cRLSign set
profile_rules.rsa_modulus: for the L-1 RSA 2048 template, unique is exactly 256 bytes, non-zero, the most-significant bit is set, and the modulus is odd
profile_rules.certificate_extension_uniqueness: a given X.509 extension OID may occur at most once
profile_rules.authority_information_access: if present, MUST be non-critical; contents are metadata only and are never used as a network trust source by this verifier
profile_rules.crl_distribution: if present, MUST be non-critical; contents are metadata only and are never used as a network trust source by this verifier
profile_rules.subject_alt_name: MUST be present; exact DER GeneralNames must include a directoryName containing exactly one TCG manufacturer, model/part-number, and firmware-version attribute; manufacturer and firmware attributes use the TCG id: form; SAN criticality is critical iff the Subject is empty
profile_rules.der_canonicality: certificate outer structure, unique-ID/Extensions wrapper cardinality, INTEGER encodings, OID base-128 encodings, BIT STRING padding, and extension critical BOOLEAN encodings are validated from exact DER
profile_rules.certificate_policies: if present, MUST be non-critical and contain at least one PolicyIdentifier; policy qualifiers are outside this reference profile
profile_rules.crl_semantics: Reference-model CRLs MUST be v2, carry nextUpdate, carry exactly non-critical AuthorityKeyIdentifier and cRLNumber extensions, bind the CRL AKI keyIdentifier exactly to the signing certificate SubjectKeyIdentifier, use the committed thisUpdate/nextUpdate and cRLNumber values, and bind every revoked entry by exact serial, revocationDate, reasonCode, and entry DER identity. The modeled validity window is thisUpdate <= verification_time < nextUpdate; this is deterministic fixture semantics and does not claim live revocation authority.

authorization_rules.trust_anchor_source: trust_anchor_source_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 digest of the exact synthetic trust-anchor authorization receipt; receipt_root_sha256 must equal the receipt's root_certificate_sha256 and the exact supplied root DER digest
authorization_rules.root_authority: the synthetic root is authorized only inside ReferenceModelOnly; a physical deployment must replace this with independently authorized real-root provenance

trust_anchor_appraisal_binding.rule: The chain verifier re-executes the exact trust-anchor appraiser source over the exact reconstructed root/registry input and requires the verifier source digest, output file digest, and verifier-produced content digest to match the bound appraisal.

spki_binding_composition.rule: The EK chain verifier re-executes the SPKI verifier against the exact leaf certificate DER and exact EK TPMT_PUBLIC bytes already bound by the chain, and independently checks verifier source, input/output file digests, and verifier-produced content digest.

path_validation_composition.rule: The EK chain verifier re-executes the standalone path verifier against the exact leaf/intermediate/root DER, exact CRL bundle, and exact verification time bound by this manifest. It requires exact verifier source, input/output file digests, semantic output content digest, and execution-policy binding.

implemented_unconditional_2_7_invariants: RSA storage EK Key Usage criticality and keyEncipherment
Authority Key Identifier mandatory and non-critical
AIA and CRL Distribution non-critical when present
Subject Directory Attributes non-critical when present
SubjectAltName present with structurally parsed TCG manufacturer/model/firmware directory attributes
Subject Key Identifier non-critical when present
exact RSA-2048 TPMT_PUBLIC modulus structure for L-1
exact RSA certificate SPKI rsaEncryption AlgorithmIdentifier parameters
canonical DER certificate structure including unique Extensions wrapper and primitive canonicality checks
Certificate Policies non-critical and structurally validated when present
exact certificate/CRL cryptographic signature binding to issuer public keys and exact TBS bytes
profile_scope.conditional_pqc_requirements: EKCredentialAlgorithmList and TPMPQCVersion are intentionally outside this v0.1 reference theorem because their correctness depends on issuer-issued PQC credentials and firmware-at-manufacturing/current-firmware evidence not present in this synthetic reference fixture.

cryptographic_binding_composition.rule: The chain verifier computes an in-process exact-signature receipt including CRL time/extension/entry semantics and exact entry DER identities, and separately re-executes the independent cryptographic witness over the same exact DER/CRL projection. Both receipts must identify the same leaf/intermediate/root/CRL byte digests and the same semantic recipe digest; the witness source, input file, and output file are separately hash-bound. The chain verifier then compares those identities with the OpenSSL path verifier's exact input object digests before profile acceptance.

session_binding_sha256: binding over verification mode, session, TPM, certificate chain, trust-anchor state/source, verification time, revocation state/method/CRL, exact CRL semantic recipe, cryptographic binding receipt, and SPKI certificate/public-key identity
